```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
dolphin <- read.csv("MPSstats.csv")
head(dolphin)
#view(dolphin)
#descriptive stats for each variable
summary(dolphin)
```

```{r}
#create model dataset
model_data <- dolphin %>%
  select(
    Dolphin.ID,
    Historical.Record.Span..years.,
    X..of.Sightings.2026.Season,
    HI.Present..1.yes.,
    Calf.Encounters.2026,
    Juvenile.Encounters.2026,
    Average.Group.Size
  )

#rename variables 
model_data <- model_data %>%
  rename(
    DolphinID = Dolphin.ID,
    RecordSpan = Historical.Record.Span..years.,
    Sightings2026 = X..of.Sightings.2026.Season,
    HI = HI.Present..1.yes.,
    CalfEncounters = Calf.Encounters.2026,
    JuvenileEncounters = Juvenile.Encounters.2026,
    AvgGroupSize = Average.Group.Size
  )

#create factor for HI (1=yes, 0=no)
model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(HI = factor(HI))

glimpse(model_data)
```

```{r}
#count #of dolphins with/without HI 
model_data %>%
  count(HI)

#count #of sightings 
model_data %>%
  count(Sightings2026)
```

#Do any variables correlate? 
```{r}
#correlation matrix 
model_data %>%
  select(
    RecordSpan,
    Sightings2026,
    CalfEncounters,
    JuvenileEncounters,
    AvgGroupSize,
  ) %>%
  cor()
```

#Objective 1: Factors Associated with Resighting Frequency -- generalized poisson regression
#response variable = #of sightings (count data, not normally distributed)
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

#Does historical record span predict resighting frequency?
model1n <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model1p <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model1gp <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding HI improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model2n <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model2p <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model2gp <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Avg Group Size improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model3n <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model3p <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model3gp <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Calf Encounters improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model4n <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfEncounters,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model4p <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfEncounters,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model4gp <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + CalfEncounters,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding Juvenile Encounters improve the explanation of resighting frequency?
model5n <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileEncounters,
  family = nbinom2,
  data = model_data
)

model5p <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileEncounters,
  family = poisson,
  data = model_data
)

model5gp <- glmmTMB(
  Sightings2026 ~ RecordSpan + HI + AvgGroupSize + JuvenileEncounters,
  family = genpois(link = "log"),
  data = model_data
)

#compare models with AIC 
AIC(model1n, model2n, model3n, model4n, model5n)
AIC(model1p, model2p, model3p, model4p, model5p)
AIC(model1gp, model2gp, model3gp, model4gp, model5gp)
```

```{r}
library(DHARMa)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model4gp,
  n = 1000
)

plot(simulationOutput)

#check model diagnostics
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testUniformity(simulationOutput)
testOutliers(simulationOutput)
```

```{r}
#what variables have significant association w/resighting frequency?
summary(model4n)
summary(model4p)
summary(model4gp)

model4n$fit$convergence 
model4p$fit$convergence #converged
model4gp$fit$convergence #converged 
```

#Objective 2: Factors Associated with HI Indicators -- logistic regression 
#response variable = HI presence (binary) 
```{r}
#Does historical record span predict HI?
HI1 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding resighting frequency improve the explanation of HI?
HI2 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan + Sightings2026,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding average group size improve explanation of HI?
HI3 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       Sightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding calf encounters improve explanation of HI?
HI4 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       Sightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize +
       CalfEncounters,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#Does adding juvenile encounters improve explanation of HI?
HI5 <- glm(
  HI ~ RecordSpan +
       Sightings2026 +
       AvgGroupSize +
       JuvenileEncounters,
  family = binomial,
  data = model_data
)

#compare models with AIC 
AIC(HI1, HI2, HI3, HI4, HI5)
```

```{r}
summary(HI5)
HI5$converged
```

```{r}
#Summary Statistics 
model_data %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_RecordSpan = mean(RecordSpan),
    SD_RecordSpan = sd(RecordSpan),
    Min_RecordSpan = min(RecordSpan),
    Max_RecordSpan = max(RecordSpan),
    
    Mean_Sightings = mean(Sightings2026),
    SD_Sightings = sd(Sightings2026),
    Min_Sightings = min(Sightings2026),
    Max_Sightings = max(Sightings2026),

    Mean_Calf = mean(CalfEncounters),
    SD_Calf = sd(CalfEncounters),
    Min_Calf = min(CalfEncounters),
    Max_Calf = max(CalfEncounters),

    Mean_Juvenile = mean(JuvenileEncounters),
    SD_Juvenile = sd(JuvenileEncounters),
    Min_Juvenile = min(JuvenileEncounters),
    Max_Juvenile = max(JuvenileEncounters),

    Mean_Group = mean(AvgGroupSize),
    SD_Group = sd(AvgGroupSize),
    Min_Group = min(AvgGroupSize),
    Max_Group = max(AvgGroupSize)
  )
```

#Figures 
```{r}
#Resighting Frequency Distribution Figure  
ggplot(model_data,
       aes(x = Sightings2026)) +
  geom_bar(fill='lightblue') +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous (
    breaks = seq(
      min(model_data$Sightings2026),
      max(model_data$Sightings2026),
      by = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "2026 Resighting Frequency (count)",
    y = "Number of Dolphins",
    title = "Resighting Frequency Distribution"
  )

```{r}
#Calf Encounters vs Resighting Frequency Figure 
ggplot(model_data,
       aes(x = CalfEncounters,
           y = Sightings2026)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              color = "red") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Calf Encounters",
    y = "2026 Resighting Frequency",
    title = "Relationship Between Calf Encounters and Resighting Frequency"
  )

# HI Presence vs Resighting Frequency Figure
model_data$HI <- factor(
  model_data$HI,
  levels = c("0", "1"),
  labels = c("No HI", "HI Present")
)
# Create boxplot with individual dolphin observations
figure_HI <- ggplot(model_data, aes(x = HI, y = Sightings2026)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "lightpink",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Human-Interaction Indicator Presence",
    y = "2026 Resighting Frequency",
    title = "Relationship Between HI Presence and Resighting Frequency"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:6,
    limits = c(0.8, 6.2)
  ) 

# Display figure
figure_HI
```

```{r}
#Historical Record Span vs HI Presence Figure 
ggplot(model_data,
       aes(x = HI,
           y = RecordSpan)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("No HI", "HI Present")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Historical Record Span by HI Presence",
    x = "Human-Interaction Indicator Presence",
    y = "Historical Record Span (years)"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggeffects)
#Predicted Probability of HI Figure
pred <- ggpredict(HI5,
                  terms = "RecordSpan")

plot(pred) +
  labs(
    title = "HI Probability by Historical Record Span",
    x = "Historical Record Span (years)",
    y = "Predicted Probability of HI Presence"
  )
```
